fixture_name: M5 Junction 10 Improvements — UK Stage 1 (real scheme, OGL)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Refuge width/depth adequacy for pedestrians and cyclists at wide A4019 junction arms next to a bus stop generator is a genuine Stage 1 geometric safety issue, not vacuous.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Verbatim quote EV-UK-015 ('not wide enough to safely house a cyclist... could be clipped by vehicles') directly supports the pivotal cyclist-exposure claim, cited with evidence_id.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a GG 119 Stage 1 safety concern with no compliance claim conflated in; null normative_basis_note is appropriate for an audit recommendation.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and actionable: names each A4019 crossing point adjacent the bus stop and the design users (expectant parent with pushchair plus cycle) whose accommodation sets the required depth/width.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians and cyclists are explicitly identified as affected road users, with pushchair-user and cycle-holding needs carried into the recommendation.
